answer: Fresh-challenge roll call gives each identity a per-round prompt from a validator-shared entropy river, then scores replies against an independent judge quorum. A valid answer needs a live-model pulse and a round-bound quill signature, blocking replays. Entry costs a per-identity bond, each attempt a priced fee, and rate caps curb probing; trust accrues over repeated passes. A fake ring cannot pool one model's output because prompts differ per identity and round, and signatures bind replies to holders.
